title: A systematic overview of the current strategies for managing cancer-related cognitive impairment in children and adolescent cancer survivors
title_zh: 儿童和青少年癌症幸存者癌症相关认知障碍当前管理策略系统综述
abstract: Childhood cancer survivors (CCSs) experience a premature onset of ageing-related morbidities, including cancer-related cognitive impairment (CRCI), attributable to epigenetic age acceleration (EAA). The National Cancer Institute (NCI) recommended non-pharmacological strategies (NPIs) as the optimal approach. To address current gaps in the literature, we conducted a systematic review of RCTs across six databases to provide a comprehensive overview of NPIs for managing CRCI in CCSs and adolescents, following the Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews of Interventions and the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-analysis (PRISMA) statement. Thirteen publications and eleven RCTs were included, including two quasi-experimental and six pilot and feasibility studies. The sample included individuals aged 4-17 years with solid brain and haematological tumours. Strategies included academic skills interventions, cognitive-motor training with digital and analogue systems, computerised and non-computerised cognitive training, web-based physical activity, and physical activity with active video gaming or exergaming. The results suggest improvements in intellectual function and cognitive abilities following structured cognitive training programs. The integration of these interventions in a coordinated survivorship care plan across healthcare, educational, and family systems will support the cognitive development and adaptive outcomes to reduce learning and social disparities in children and adolescents with cancer. Further RCTs are needed to allow for rigorous quantitative data synthesis and to target specific age groups.
abstract_zh: 儿童癌症幸存者（CCSs）经历过早衰老相关的合并症，其中包括归因于表观遗传年龄加速（EAA）的癌症相关认知障碍（CRCI）。美国国家癌症研究所（NCI）建议非药物干预（NPIs）为最优方法。为解决文献中的当前空白，我们对六大数据库进行了系统综述，旨在全面综合非药物干预措施，以管理儿童和青少年癌症幸存者中的CRCI，遵循《Cochrane手册：干预措施系统评价》和首选报告项目系统评价和荟萃分析声明（PRISMA声明）。共纳入13篇论文和11项随机对照试验（RCTs），其中包括2项准实验研究和6项试点和可行性研究。研究对象包括4-17岁患有实体脑肿瘤和血液肿瘤的个体。干预策略包括学业技能干预、结合数字和模拟系统的认知-运动训练、计算机化和非计算机化认知训练、基于网络的体育活动以及结合主动视频游戏或外挂游戏的体育活动。结果表明，结构化认知训练项目后，智力功能和认知能力有所改善。这些干预措施在跨医疗、教育和家庭系统的协调康复计划中的整合，有助于支持儿童和青少年的认知发展和自适应结果，从而降低患癌儿童和青少年的学习和社会差异。需要进一步的RCTs，以允许进行严谨的定量数据综合，并针对特定年龄组。
